_about: 2-Butanone (1) + Ethanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-butanone, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-butanone, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Li, Wenxiu, Li, Linhao, Zhang, Liyue, Li, Honghui, Zhang, Tao, Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium for 2-butanone + ethanol + phosphate-based ionic liquids at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 456 (2018) 57-64
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3, 4. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0049. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.25 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
